findings.desc: doc-code-drift: proofstory slicing surface is internally inconsistent. docs/requirements/decisions/proofstory-intent-collision-execution-plan.md lines 419-431 still say the initial MVP only reports proofstory_gate_check --dryRun and that durable slice plans are future parent-child orchestration, but lines 967-1080 list slice_plan_set, parent_ledger_rollup_set, slice-plan.json, and parent-ledger-rollup.json as implemented MVP artifacts. Align the earlier slicing section with the bounded implemented slicing surface while preserving the no-auto-child-story claim.
findings.resolvedReason: Aligned the early slicing section with the implemented bounded MVP: proofstory_gate_check diagnostics plus slice_plan_set/slice-plan.json and parent_ledger_rollup_set/parent-ledger-rollup.json, while preserving no automatic child-story creation or parent DONE orchestration. Verified with npm --prefix packages/main run build, proofstory-intent-hardening-smoke, verify-process-fact-contract, and git diff --check.

findings.desc: High-assurance DONE equivalence currently treats high_assurance itself as a milestone path: packages/main/src/core/proofstory.ts:1267-1270 includes hardeningLevel === high_assurance in hasMilestonePath, and packages/main/src/core/proofstory.ts:1321-1328 then fails missing_confirmed_milestone_ledger when no confirmed ledger exists. That violates the progressive model in docs/requirements/decisions/proofstory-intent-collision-execution-plan.md:90-95, where the confirmed milestone ledger is only required if one exists, and M9 at docs/requirements/decisions/proofstory-intent-collision-execution-plan.md:1293-1300 lists high-assurance requirements as intent collision/red/spike/review escalation, not a milestone ledger. The smoke coverage only proves low-risk single-outcome lightweight DONE at packages/main/src/tasks/proofstory-intent-hardening-smoke.ts:617-619, so a single-outcome high-assurance story can be incorrectly blocked at DONE for missing milestone-ledger.json even though milestone intent was never triggered.
findings.resolvedReason: Removed high_assurance as a standalone milestone-path trigger in evaluateDoneIntentEquivalence. Added smoke coverage proving a high-assurance single-outcome story without milestone ledger/slice/shrinkage uses lightweight_single_outcome and passes DONE equivalence with original snapshot plus accepted summary. Verified with npm --prefix packages/main run build, proofstory-intent-hardening-smoke, verify-process-fact-contract, and git diff --check.

findings.desc: red_evidence_create can satisfy the ProofStory red-evidence gate without command or green/current evidence: command-catalog.ts makes failingCommand/expectedGreenCommand/greenHeadHash/greenMaterialHash optional, handlers/proofstory.ts auto-fills baseline hashes from the current tree, and proofstory.ts redEvidenceRecordSatisfied returns true once observedFailure, target, baseline hashes, and a same-target greenRelation exist. For a bug/regression story in proofStory.devGateMode=enforce, a natural-language observedFailure row with no failing command, no receipt/transcript, and no green hash/command can clear missing_red_evidence even though the requirement says valid red evidence must include command, baseline, expected/observed-before result, intent mapping, and receipt/digest. This weakens an L4 gate-evidence producer consumed by DEV/REVIEW/DONE ProofStory gates.
findings.resolvedReason: Strengthened redEvidenceRecordSatisfied so gate satisfaction requires observed failure, target ref, baseline head/material, failing command or failureReceiptHash, and current green command/hash relation; green hashes must differ from baseline when present. Exposed failureReceiptHash in CLI/handler/types, updated command policy/docs/process contract, and added smoke cases for missing red proof and missing green proof. Verified with npm --prefix packages/main run build, proofstory-intent-hardening-smoke, verify-process-fact-contract, and git diff --check.
